f.title: Provide the PSMF on request to inform inspections
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders are required to provide, on request, the pharmacovigilance system master file, which will be used to inform inspection conduct.
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by GVP Module III Rev 1 (EMA/119871/2012 Rev 1).

f.title: Locate the PSMF at the main EU PV site or where the QPPV operates
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance system master file shall be located either at the site in the Union where the main pharmacovigilance activities of the MAH are performed or at the site in the Union where the QPPV operates; the supervisory authority is the competent authority of the Member State in which the PSMF is located.
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by GVP Module III Rev 1 (EMA/119871/2012 Rev 1).

rows.quote: The supervisory authority for pharmacovigilance shall be the competent authority of the Member State in which the pharmacovigilance system master file is located [REG Art 18(3)]. According to article 7(1) of the Commission Implementation Regulation (EU) No 520/2012 (Implementing Regulation is referenced as IR) the pharmacovigilance system master file shall be located either at the site in the Union where the main pharmacovigilance activities of the marketing authorisation holder are performed or at the site in the Union where the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance operates.
rows.review_note: Review: Applicability prefix now names the replacing revision (Rev 1). No other change. Double-check: Superseded/draft version; no previous_key link to the current baseline (current text is GVP III Rev 2, curated separately). Two shall clauses (supervisory authority; PSMF location) merged; MAH actor inferred for the location duty.

f.statement: Non-compliance should be rectified by the MAH in a timely manner through the implementation of a corrective and preventive action plan.

f.title: Provide information requested for risk-based inspection planning
f.statement: National competent authorities and the Agency may solicit information from marketing authorisation holders for risk-based inspection planning purposes if it is not readily available elsewhere.

f.title: Any party performing PV on behalf of the MAH may be inspected
f.statement: Any party carrying out pharmacovigilance activities in whole or in part, on behalf of, or in conjunction with the marketing authorisation holder may be inspected, in order to confirm its capability to support the marketing authorisation holder's compliance with pharmacovigilance obligations.

f.title: Take the rectifying steps and timeframes specified in warning letters or infringement notices
f.statement: Where a competent authority issues a warning letter, non-compliance statement or infringement notice under national legislation, the marketing authorisation holder must take the steps it specifies to rectify the non-compliance within the timeframe it sets.
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by GVP Module III Rev 1 (EMA/119871/2012 Rev 1).

f.title: Be inspection-ready at all times (inspections may be unannounced)
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders with authorised products and applicants who have submitted new centralised applications are subject to pharmacovigilance inspections and have responsibilities including always being inspection-ready, as inspections may be unannounced.
f.clause: III.C.5. Role of the Marketing Authorisation Holders and Applicants
f.applicability: Superseded version, replaced by GVP Module III Rev 1 (EMA/119871/2012 Rev 1).

rows.quote: Marketing authorisation holders with authorised products and applicants who have submitted new applications under the centralised procedure are subject to pharmacovigilance inspections (see III.B.1). Therefore both have responsibilities in relation to inspections, including but not limited to the following: • Always to be inspection-ready as inspections may be unannounced.
